name: Threads of Karma
body:
School evocation [void]; Level psychic 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Casting Time 3 rounds

Components V, S, DF

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target you and one willing intelligent creature

Duration up to 1 hour/level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

Void: Spells with this descriptor are tied with a philosophical school of magic based on a concept known as the Void. The school teaches that the Void is the nothingness from which springs forth creativity, insight, spirit, thought, and also the source of pure energy from which all elements and phenomena are derived. Channeling the power of the Void (or the Void element) allows for the manipulation of the elements in objects and creatures, among other possibilities. Spells with the void descriptor are considered to belong to the Void element (for geomancers) and the void elemental school (for void elementalists).

If a spell has the [void] descriptor, it cannot be dispelled by elements release regardless of how high is your CL.

One of the few known spells involving karma, you can establish a temporary karmic connection within the Void between you and another intelligent (Int 3 or higher) creature. This connection manifests within the Void as an invisible and intangible golden thread, enabling a sharing of each other’s spiritual reserves.

Either you or the target creature can dismiss this spell at any time.

While this spell lasts, as a swift action, you may donate any number of available ki points from your ki pool to the target creature’s ki pool or vice-versa. Only ki points that are replenished in the ki pool each day can be donated in this way. Ki points donated cannot be donated back to the donor nor soon replenished after use.

Any unused donated ki points return back to their original owners when this spell ends. Each donated ki point that is used equally diminishes the maximum capacity of the donor’s ki pool. The ki pool retains this diminished capacity until its next daily replenishment.

A creature can only be under the effects of a single casting of threads of karma at a time and cannot be affected again by threads of karma until at least an amount of time equal to the elapsed duration of the previous casting of this spell for them has passed.
